title: Metrics golden signals
proves: The golden-signal families marked present in golden-signals.json are really exposed by a booted API and worker behind a bearer token, with latency histogram samples and an error-class label.
doesNotProve: Job metrics (queue duration, jobs_total, dead letters) only get samples when a job runs, so live they are noted, not asserted. Web, realtime and Redis exporter families are not checked live.
